# Angel vs VC

> Fit table for a first check: angel or VC. Not a ranking.

- Live investor names, counts, and matches are only on https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match. This repo is criteria and methodology, not the database.
- Product: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match
- Canonical facts: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded
- Fundraising is super easy when the stage matches the check.
- Not a fund. Not an accelerator. No Y Combinator / Antler / Techstars / 500 Global partnership claims.
